goals.title: Reach Catacombs 30 for M-floor gear
goals.method: Run F7 / M3 with a full team; use Bonzo/Spirit masks.
goals.rationale: F7 gives ~2x the XP of F6. Master Mode M3 is better once you can survive it.
goals.destination: Dungeon Hub → Catacombs F7 / Master Mode

steps.title: Clear F6 until it is consistent
Move up to F7 — roughly 2x the XP of F6
Try Master Mode M3 once you can survive it

goals.title: Save for Hyperion
goals.method: Bazaar flip on the side while doing Diana events.
goals.rationale: Wither Impact is the single biggest clear-speed and quality-of-life jump in the game.

goals.title: Enderman Slayer 7
goals.rationale: Eman 7 unlocks the Terminator, a core mid-game damage upgrade.

goals.title: Magical Power 800
goals.method: Focus on cheap epic/legendary talismans first.
goals.rationale: Magical Power is the cheapest stat bulk in the game.

steps.title: Buy missing talismans from the auction house

advisor.title: Get a Term / Necron's Blade path started
advisor.desc: Terminator (~200m) or Wither Blade gear are the biggest single upgrades for mid-game dungeon and slayer players.

advisor.title: Catacombs 27 → 30
advisor.desc: Cata 30 lets you run early Master Mode floors for essence and Master Star profits.

advisor.title: Enderman Slayer 4 → 7
advisor.desc: Eman slayer gives the best Combat XP/hour and Judgement Core / Exceedingly Rare drops fund late-game upgrades.

advisor.title: Heart of the Mountain 6 → 7
advisor.desc: HOTM 7 unlocks Mineshafts and the strongest gemstone powder perks. Massive mining income boost.

advisor.title: Farming 28 → 30
advisor.desc: Farming is the most reliable early money + Farming Contest medals for Anita's upgrades.

advisor.title: Revenant Slayer 6 → 7
advisor.desc: Rev 7 unlocks Reaper gear & Crooked Artifact recipe; Rev is the cheapest slayer to level and drops valuable Revenant Flesh.
